title: GDD T-111 — MECH_06 ¡PERSIGUE!/¡ESCAPA! + MECH_07 ¡BOMBARDEA! (asimétricas 1v3, §4)
description: The two 1v3 asymmetric mechanics per GDD §4, on the canonical v2 contract, balance-verified with the TASK-038 bot harness. MECH_06: arena with 2-3 cover obstacles; solo role rotates ROUND-ROBIN forced by the system across the session (never the same seat twice in a row); modes soloHunts (solo catches the 3) and soloFlees (the 3 catch the solo, solo wins surviving duration); the solo compensates 1-vs-3 ONLY with mobility (+15% speed, longer dash) — never different rules (hard design rule); dash on tap with exact 1.5 s cooldown. MECH_07 (inverted power): solo aims a reticle, each shot telegraphs the zone 0.7 s before impact (NEVER damage without visible warning — P4 guarantee), fire cadence 1/0.9 s with max queue of 1; solo scores per hit, the trio scores by surviving. Balance bands measured with Bot.Medio over 1000 seeds: MECH_06 corral test (3 coordinated bots catch an optimal solo in < duration in >= 40% of seeds) and MECH_07 winrate in [40%, 60%]. Both declare soloSpeedBonus etc. as data for remote recalibration. Read GDD §4 MECH_06/MECH_07 + D.3 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Both mechanics implement the v2 contract, engine-free, seeded, zero-alloc steady Tick
MECH_06 solo rotation verified round-robin over a full simulated session (never same seat consecutively; system-forced, never chosen)
MECH_06 corral test: 3 coordinated Bot.Medio catch an optimal solo bot within duration in >= 40% of 1000 seeds; dash cooldown exact at tick resolution
MECH_07 telegraph: >= 0.5 s guaranteed between telegraph visibility in RenderState and damage application (timeline test); solo cannot queue more than 1 pending shot
MECH_07 winrate with calibrated bots in the [40, 60]% band over 1000 seeds; both mechanics' balance knobs are definition data passing the validator
Solo balance is mobility-only: identical rule set both sides asserted structurally (shared verb/collision logic, no role-specific rule branches beyond speed/dash params)
Tests-first; fast suite green after, no regression

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Carry-in from the TASK-050 close (rev-t050 LOW-1, 2026-07-07), relevant when authoring the MECH_06/MECH_07 asym definitions: the v2 validator requires asym1v3 payoutTable length 4 (same ranked shape as competitive; RoundRecord.Places is length-4 ranked for every dynamics). GDD 7.2's asym payout values ('gana quien es Jefe al agotarse el tiempo — recompensa 6 monedas; atacantes 2') author in that shape as [6,2,2,2] (attackers tie via shared places; ApplyCompetitive supports tie-sharing). Also amend the overstated comment in MicrogameDefinitionValidatorTests.cs:163-171/:194-197 ('GDD gives asym no separate payout description' -> 'no separate SHAPE; 7.2 gives values 6/2, expressible as [6,2,2,2]') on the first touch of that file.
